purpose: close the last open Phase 6 finding: analyzer.analyze-trace@1 kind=context was refused on real traces, leaving PHASE_6_SCENARIO.md section 6 item 4 unmet

finding.originalReason: analyzer.schemaMismatch: trace-analysis@1 produced JSON outside ArkTrace analysis contract 1.0
finding.rootCause: a counter is a step function, so the value in force at a window's start was written before the window; ArkTrace carries that sample in, while ArkDeck validateCounterSample required every sample timestamp to satisfy timestamp >= startNs

fix.rule: a sample before the window is admitted only when it declares a durationNs whose end reaches the window, and a series accepts at most one such sample; in-window samples and the exclusive far edge are unchanged

baselineRound.carryInRuleSatisfied: every carry-in reaches past the window start and no series carries more than one

scenarioImpact.requirement: at least one context result around the hottest interval
scenarioImpact.metricsAffected: none; M1 to M5 never depended on the context kind, so the recorded improved verdict is unchanged
